title: Everyday Market from Woolworths: 20% Cashback on $150.01+ Spend (Uncapped) @ TopCashback AU
body:
Deal: Everyday Market from Woolworths: 20% Cashback on $150.01+ Spend (Uncapped) @ TopCashback AU

[Vorsprungdurchtech] was looking to buy another Unifi G5 Turret, thought i'd take a look to compare the $165 on amazon, $339 here aka $271 after cashback.
[csgooo] is this covered? https://www.woolworths.com.au/shop/productdetails/1108321507…
[LHSolutions] Is postage shipping cost included in the cashback or excluded?
[Prostagma] It’s uncommon for them to do uncapped isn’t it?
[Bigbanger666] Utilised a similar deal a couple months ago with TopCashback for DDR5 memory and the cashback was denied a couple weeks ago by Woolworths with no reason, I did not use a VPN, adblock or anything of the sort. So just be a bit wary.
